headline: Food Prices Could Explode: Dramatic Warning from One of the Key Sources
summary: Ukraine could run out of grain storage space by November, when the new harvest arrives, unless exports speed up. Alternative export routes are being sought.
why: Ukraine is a major global exporter of wheat, corn and sunflower products, so export logistics and storage constraints can affect world grain supply and prices.
